observations.content: Completed item 1: YouTube frame extraction works; fetch_content returned 3 frames at 0:08, 0:13, 0:18 from a YouTube video.

Fixed infrastructure for yt-dlp: installed standalone yt-dlp binary to ~/.local/bin, added --js-runtimes node to ~/.config/yt-dlp/config at config level, and replaced ~/.local/bin/ffmpeg + ffprobe with BtbN master build (old static build segfaulted on DASH streams).
Assistant noted its model (glm-5.3 via zaicp/cli-openai provider) lacks image input support; frames come back as tool_result images but the model cannot see them.

Priorities per user (Vietnamese): items needing user action should be done first; guided-choice spawn (item E) and user-side commands (item F) deferred, guided-choice spawn deferred to last since it blocks the turn until user answers via ask_user_question.

Read pdf-reader skill at /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.pi/skills/pdf-reader/SKILL.md: uses venv SKILL_DIR/.venv with pymupdf, scripts pdf_info.py (metadata/math density/image count), pdf_extract.py, pdf_render.py, pdf_search.py; strategy of render then read image with vision.

Created a fake scanned invoice as image-only PDF at /tmp/scan_test.pdf (and /tmp/scan_page.png) using pymupdf: text of a Vietnamese fake invoice (CONG TY TNHH PI-TEST, HOA DON BAN LE so 001-2026, TONG CONG: 980.000 VND) embedded only as a bitmap with no text layer.

Model audit subagent returned report on 151 session files: glm-5.3 best (437 calls, excellent thinking, diagnosed root causes), glm-5.3-flash good but dithers, MiniMax-M3 stable API but 80% of calls leak thinking inline into text channel, deepseek-v4-flash reliable budget worker, glm-5.2 idle with no fresh evidence.

Audit concluded MiniMax-M3 instability is an output-format defect not API instability; recommendation is to demote MiniMax-M3 from scout role or keep with caveat, possibly switch scout model to glm-5.3-flash (cheap, stable format).
Audit findings confirmed user's suspicion that MiniMax-M3 reads as unstable in the UI (stray response fragments leaked into visible replies, e.g. text block 151c7540 ending with 'contents.').

Ran pdf_info, pdf_extract, pdf_render on /tmp/scan_test.pdf: pdf_info reported text_length 0 and image_count 1 (correctly detecting scanned nature), extract returned empty, render produced /tmp/pi-pdf-1181225e2f/page_0001.png.

Read tool on rendered PNG returned the note that the current model (glm-5.3 via zaicp/cli-openai) does not support images, so the vision half of pdf-reader could not be executed directly by the assistant.
Assistant noted distinction: glm-5.3-flash has vision while glm-5.3 (main) does not; this morning's vision tests succeeded by calling a subagent on glm-5.3-flash.

Spawned scout agent fa19ce57-1733-425d-85a9-67008064ec67 named scan-vision with model override to cli-openai/zaicp/glm-5.3-flash to read the rendered scan PNG and transcribe it, also testing the spawn model-override param for the first time.

scan-vision scout finished and transcribed the fake invoice exactly (CONG TY TNHH PI-TEST, HOA DON BAN LE so 001-2026, two line items, TONG CONG: 980.000 VND, Bao hanh 12 thang), even verifying arithmetic 2 x 250.000 + 1 x 480.000 = 980.000.

Completed item 3: PDF scan end-to-end works via vision delegation through scout subagent with glm-5.3-flash; established that spawn model override works and vision delegation via glow-5.3-flash is the standard pattern for anything needing eyes.

Started OM INDEX fix: grepped observational-memory extension; found INDEX.md written by renderIndexFile in src/memory/index-render.ts, re-rendered after consolidation at consolidator-trigger.ts:144, and listTopics in src/memory/paths.ts lists .md files except INDEX.md/JOURNEY.md.

Hypothesized root cause of 'No topics yet' INDEX: topic files on disk sit at .memory/<sessionId>/.memory/*.md (nested .memory) while listTopics lists .memory/<sessionId>/*.md, a two-level nesting mismatch.

Confirmed root cause via code read: spawnWorker at consolidator-trigger.ts:122 runs the consolidator subprocess with cwd = runtime.memoryRoot (.memory/<sessionId>), and the consolidator prompt says to write durable topic files 'under .memory/', so the child resolves .memory/ relative to its cwd and writes one level too deep at .memory/<sessionId>/.memory/.

buildConsolidatorPrompt (consolidator-trigger.ts) injects current time, rendered index, journey text (read via readJourney(memoryRoot)), and observations as lines of `<timestamp-id>  <content>`; instructs consolidator to fold observations into topic files, update .memory/JOURNEY.md under ~journeyTargetTokens tokens, finish with one-sentence confirmation.

Consolidator is deliberately NOT tracked in observerTasks so compaction waits only for in-flight observers, never the consolidator (design R5); consolidatorInFlight flag enforces one-at-a-time; on clean exit it trusts the consolidator and re-folds against the current branch to avoid tombstoning observations committed during the run.
